rules.quote: Applicants must be final-year students pursuing B.E/B.Tech in core Civil/Electrical Engineering, expected to graduate in 2026 from a recognized Indian University/Institute
with an academic aggregate of 70% or a CGPA of 7.0 (out of 10) and above.
Please note that students from other engineering disciplines and those who graduated in 2025 or earlier are not eligible.

rules.value: M.Tech Construction Technology & Management at IIT Madras / IIT Delhi / NITK Surathkal / NIT Trichy
rules.quote: 02 years full-time M.Tech degree in Construction Technology & Management (CTaM)

rules.value: Rs 12 lakh undertaking and 5-year service bond with L&T
rules.quote: Upon selection and before joining the course, the student is required to sign an undertaking valued at Rs. 12 lakhs.
If shortlisted, you will be required to appear for a physical written test at one of our designated Test Centres.

amount.text: Full tuition/sponsorship fee paid to IIT/NIT plus stipend Rs 13,400 per month for 24 months; employment at L&T on completion
amount.quote: Monthly stipend of Rs. 13,400 will be paid for 24 months (till the course completion)

documents.name: Certificates, mark sheets, photo ID, photograph, signature, CV
documents.quote: Documents like certificates / mark sheets / valid photo identity proof / photograph / signature / CV etc., need to be uploaded.
